title: Q-RES-open-loops-2026-O5: The system starts its own work (measured 0.203, target >= 0.5)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: open-loops-2026 finding O5 is not-met (measured 0.203)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe open-loops-2026:O5
**Prediction:** system_authored_share >= 0.5 within 336 h
**Status:** closed

Concern: The system starts its own work. The study: Belief: an AI system only does what a person asks. Test: share of merged pull requests the system's own loops opened.

Mechanisms that should answer it: SELF-REFERENCE-1 (foundation/executor.py).

Metric: share of merged pull requests opened by the system itself, target >= 0.5. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.7 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
